title: Freight collection needs confirmed pallet dimensions and weight

plan.situation: Plover Arc Logistics' freight booking desk can't allocate a collection vehicle for DL-043 because the pallet's dimensions and weight fields are blank (event 001). Nessa Dray, shipping coordinator at the shipper Orris Span, says the pallet is ready and asks which measurements the carrier needs (event 002). Only the shipper has these measured values.

facts.fact: DL-043 has one pallet at Orris Span Fabrication; its dimensions and weight fields are blank.
The carrier can't allocate a collection vehicle until the pallet size is given.
The shipper must provide measured values before the planner allocates a vehicle.
Nessa Dray says the pallet is ready and asks which measurements are needed.
No collection date, slot or cutoff is recorded.

missing_information: Measured pallet length, width and height, including the pallet base
Gross weight of the loaded pallet, including the pallet
Whether the pallet can be stacked, and any special handling notes, if the carrier's booking needs them
risk_flags: No collection time or vehicle has been given by the carrier, so none can be promised
Values must be measured, not estimated, as Context requires

authority_map.controls: Measured pallet dimensions and weight (the missing datum)

authority_map.party: Plover Arc Logistics freight booking desk
authority_map.controls: Vehicle allocation, collection booking and slot

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: No earlier desk promise; event 002 is a new question from the shipper

plan.decision_summary: Reply to Nessa Dray in the Business portal listing the exact measured values Plover Arc needs for DL-043, then send them to the carrier's freight booking desk once received.
plan.rationale: The block is a missing datum that only the shipper holds. Nessa has asked what is needed, so the next step is to ask her, in the channel she used, for exactly the carrier's blank fields: dimensions and weight, measured. The carrier can't act until these arrive.

actions.subject: DL-043 – pallet measurements needed for the collection booking
actions.purpose: Get the measured pallet dimensions and weight the carrier needs to allocate a vehicle
actions.body:
Hello Nessa,

Thanks for confirming the pallet for DL-043 is ready. Plover Arc Logistics' freight booking desk can't allocate a collection vehicle yet because the pallet's dimensions and weight are blank on the booking. Please reply here with values measured from the actual pallet (not estimates):

1. Length (cm)
2. Width (cm)
3. Height (cm), measured from the floor to the highest point, including the pallet base
4. Gross weight (kg), meaning the full loaded weight including the pallet

If the load can't be stacked or needs special handling, please say so too.

When you send these, I'll pass them straight to the freight booking desk so they can allocate a vehicle. Please note that this is a request for information, not a booking confirmation. I can't confirm a collection date or vehicle until Plover Arc gives one.

Kind regards,
Iona Quill
Rivet Delivery Desk

actions.purpose: Log the pending datum and the next step
actions.body: DL-043: Plover Arc freight booking desk (event 001) is waiting for pallet dimensions and weight. Asked Nessa Dray (Orris Span) via Business portal on 2026-03-16 for measured L/W/H incl. pallet base and gross weight incl. pallet. When received, email the values to the Freight booking desk, Plover Arc Logistics. No collection slot is recorded.

not_doing: Not estimating or proposing pallet dimensions or weight, because only measured values from the shipper count
Not promising a collection date, vehicle or slot, because Plover Arc hasn't given one
Not emailing the carrier yet, because there is no new data to send them
Not scheduling a timed follow-up, because there is no slot or time in the record to tie it to
plan.follow_up: When Nessa sends the measured values, email them to the Freight booking desk, Plover Arc Logistics, and ask them to allocate a vehicle and confirm with a booking reference. If Nessa doesn't reply, send a Business portal reminder within the working day. If Plover Arc sets a collection slot, chase the measurements before that slot lapses.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Reply to Nessa Dray in the Business portal listing the exact measured values Plover Arc needs for DL-043, then send them to the carrier's freight booking desk once received.

issues.problem: The message adds details the carrier never asked for: units (cm/kg), the instruction to measure height 'from the floor including the pallet base', and stacking or special-handling notes. Event 001 only says dimensions and weight are blank. These details are sensible and marked optional, but they are not grounded in the record.
issues.fix: You can keep them as phrased. Optionally, say they are standard details and the carrier may confirm its exact format.

issues.problem: The 'not_doing' list says no timed follow-up will be scheduled, but 'follow_up' sets a portal reminder within the working day. The plan contradicts itself.
issues.fix: Make the two consistent, e.g. record a same-day internal reminder to check for Nessa's reply.

review.summary: The plan answers the shipper's new question in the channel she used. It asks only for the measured pallet dimensions and weight the carrier is missing, promises no collection slot, and correctly holds off contacting the carrier until there are values to send. The only issues are minor: some measurement details aren't in the record, and the follow-up wording contradicts itself.
